For a hypothetical 5-year illustration, $10,000.00 earns a constant 5.0% gross annual return. Model fees by subtracting 0.80% from the return each year before annual compounding. There are no contributions, withdrawals, or taxes. How much lower is the ending balance than in the same illustration with no fee? Round to the nearest cent.
explanation: No-fee ending value = $10,000.00 × (1 + 5/100)^5 = $12,762.82. Modeled fee-adjusted value = $10,000.00 × [1 + (5 − 0.80)/100]^5 = $12,283.97. Difference = $478.85. These assumed returns are not a forecast.
